correctness.rationale: For each insertion of a transposition on two fixed labels, direct inversion-indicator comparison gives the exact strictly positive increment. Constant in/out degree makes every matching-class marginal exactly uniform. Random-ordering exposure gives conditional variance at most 16n³, and a strictly decreasing ratio of successive fixed-point weights gives concentration at the unique root of s²=a²(1-s), including endpoints. Pair-interaction averaging yields the exact conditional inversion mean. Uniform conditional Chebyshev convergence and continuity prove the inversion-density law. The standalone actual verify.py passed 13,230 enumerations, 45,612 increment checks and 36 rational covariance cases; these finite checks supplement the proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected 1982, 2004 and 2014 literature already determines complete finite joint fixed-point/inversion enumerators. That substantive prior coverage is not claimed as a new enumerator or ignored. The assessed claim is the strict simultaneous monotone coupling across all transposition classes, its stochastic-order implication for every positive fugacity, and a nonconstant inversion-density law of large numbers under a square-root-changing fugacity. Those are nontrivial cross-class inequalities and limits not stated by the inspected classical polynomial recurrences. The exact mean is used solely as a known-derived ingredient. Real semantic published-finding corpus and local ledger checks found no matching structural theorem. Historical implicit derivability from existing complete polynomials remains a material residual risk; this is not independent proof of priority.
residual_risks: Existing exact bivariate inversion enumerators encode every finite distribution; a previously unstated equivalent cross-class comparison may be derivable from their identities, and independent mathematical-priority verification is outstanding.

value.rationale: The natural statistics are matching density and inversion density in the complete involution/partial-matching model. Strict stochastic ordering controls all increasing functions and all inversion thresholds, not merely a single mean or covariance. The square-root fugacity gives a complete nonconstant continuum of inversion-density limits between 1/4 and 0. This structural interpolation motivates the precise parameter regime and is not an arbitrary finite example, renamed known enumerator, or unsupported application.
